scope: Native project intake across all thirteen Crafts and reusable common source media

sourceBase.changes: Uncommitted local changes in both repositories; source hashes identify this acceptance state

migration.state: Validated with all migrations in isolated PGlite tests; not applied to a deployed database; requires the existing verified migration-ledger workflow

behaviour: Recognised native files select their Craft and name automatically. Self-contained projects save and open immediately.

The same per-Craft runtime package checks reject missing/unsafe/nested links before any asset write. A creator adds linked files or chooses a containing folder; multiple native masters require one project choice.
Only the selected master and referenced files are saved from native folders. Original bytes and relative paths survive; unrelated files and an empty compacted LightCraft journal are excluded.
LightCraft master filenames and FilmCraft extension casing are normalized for the existing published adapters without changing source bytes.
PNG/JPG/JPEG/SVG/WebP/GIF, WAV/MP3/FLAC/OGG/M4A and MP4/MOV/WebM import as source assets with no owning Craft. Multiple supported source files create separate assets and open the final preview.
Image insertion exports retain the exact original bytes. Existing Place from studio controls choose how a source is used. No automatic native conversion or forced default Craft.
Source asset and first revision creation are atomic and owner-scoped; exact replays reuse them after uncertain replies. The ordinary source revision route stays closed to later edits.
Small source images can supply library covers; larger originals are not loaded as gallery thumbnails.
Pause/continue and dirty-work protection remain in place.

checks.testTransport: Actual components, isolated BFF fixtures and an actual loopback TUS receiver; only the owned Chromium QA context receives loopback permission. No production data.
exploratoryChecks: Unsupported documents require explicit native-format handling
Missing and nested model resources block before writes
Lost creation and commit responses preserve import identity
Real SVG artwork with unsupported text remains a source and CADCraft explains its placement limitation
No horizontal overflow or clipped controls in the reviewed desktop states

cadRoundTrip.environment: Actual published editor and installed native CLI; isolated project/BFF/Storage fixtures
checks: Native DXF directly imported and opened
New local SVG source placed through the actual Place from studio picker
Ctrl+S confirmed a new immutable DXF revision with the exact SVG source revision dependency
Native CLI loaded 24 entities with zero skipped records
Native continuation added a line and saved 25 entities with zero skipped records

sourcePlayback.svg: Preview decoded and reopened from library
sourcePlayback.wav: Actual 8-second WAV played through browser controls
sourcePlayback.mp4: Actual H.264/AAC MP4 played through browser controls

limits: This is local acceptance, not a deployment or new editor release. Existing editor/workstation pins are unchanged.

Published-editor checks for the ten additional Crafts were on desktop Chromium; the other browser counts cover host intake/transfers through a transport peer. Only CADCraft has a new full native continuation in this extension; the earlier WordCraft round trip is recorded separately.
Native links must form a portable package. Unsupported external references, un-compacted LightCraft journals, corrupt/unsupported native versions and missing media require correction before import.
Common files remain reusable sources. Each Craft retains its own insertion and codec limits; importing a file does not promise conversion into every native format.
Directory drops lead to the folder picker. Mixed unrelated native projects require a project choice; this is not a general folder organizer.
Director first-draft and blank-document proposals remain outside this import change.
